translations.web: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!
translations.bsb: My soul cleaves to the dust; revive me according to Your word.
translations.kjv: DALETH. My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.
translations.asv: DALETH. My soul cleaveth unto the dust: Quicken thou me according to thy word.
